description:
`copy_from_pinned_async` and `copy_to_pinned_async` (`crates/gf2-kernels-hip/src/host/alloc.rs:296-298`) are safe functions whose soundness is reported to rely on the caller keeping the pinned buffer alive until the stream synchronizes; `init_permanent_gf7_from_slices` (`permanent/mod.rs`) is a safe function that requires an active HIP context.

## Background

Reported by the gf2-kernels-hip comment sweep. `@/inv/unsafe-kernel-isolation` requires an explicit safety contract at every unsafe boundary.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test reproduces the reported behavior at the cited location, or a record shows the report does not hold and the issue is rejected with that evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each function is `unsafe` with a `# Safety` contract, or its signature enforces the obligation (a borrow tied to the stream, a context token).
title: Safe HIP functions rely on unstated caller obligations
